Name: Hananiah, Captain of the King
Summary: Hananiah, one of the king's captains, oversaw the numbering of Uzziah's army by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler.
KeyStory: The army's account was under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.
LifeLesson: A captain's oversight kept a great host in order.
